checks: Production exposes only the frontend and isolates the database network
Trusted test certificate, TLS 1.2/1.3, HTTP redirect, HSTS, CSP and direct SPA URL
Runtime is non-superuser, cannot perform DDL or mutate audit, and can append/read audit
Entire backend suite including real PostgreSQL workflow passes without skipped integration
Production role supports account create/reset/role revocation, legacy passwords and rejects forwarded-IP throttle bypass
Synthetic import, worker, apply, source download and checkpoint work with production DB privileges
Production logs exclude credentials/tokens and backup refuses a running writer
Backup refuses to overwrite an existing restore database
Restore reproduces all 13 table digests, every file hash, working login, active dataset and original KML
